tests.scope: Synthetic saved-array fixtures only; reduced mocked six-model I/O cohort and intentionally invalid prior bytes. No new scientific outcomes inspected, no real-array decomposition or model inference executed.

reviewed_contracts: Exactly risk-random, risk-speed and speed-random comparisons on the original six100k models and27x11 histories each. No new graphs, permutation nulls, native outcomes or110k endpoints.

Pinned prior action-result/status/input-identity hashes anchor original output inventories. Strict full-model data/config/runtime/source/coverage gates and replay of every saved action scalar/derived array precede new grouping.

Simple optional pairs, exact equal budgets and optional incidence are checked through frozen action replay. Four masks partition all particles; less/equal/more optional degree partitions only the both-covered group.

Normalized coordinate errors, alignment and perturbation costs divide vector quantities by2. Per-particle and group error=cost difference−alignment difference use the predeclared cancellation envelope; signed adverse values remain.

Four unconditional contributions reconstruct whole-frame paired error/alignment/cost/degree differences. Both subgroups reconstruct both. Masks/counts/budgets are exact, and additive identities are checked after trajectory, seed and three-seed averaging.

Empty groups have valid zero fractions/contributions and null conditional means. Conditional frame averages require every fixed frame; separately labeled weighted conditionals divide weighted contribution by weighted fraction. Tests distinguish this from averaging available conditional frames.

Frame then equal-trajectory weighting precedes exactly three seed means/sample SD. Different particle counts never induce particle pooling. Missing/invalid/failed required inputs null the relevant complete-population summaries.

Failed source frames remain all-null. Corrupt source/provenance never yields favorable unvalidated policy subsets. The pure helper can demonstrate action-specific null propagation while main retains stronger original integrity rules.

New output directories preserve prior attempts. Invalid readable prior action JSON/NPZ retain expected and observed paths/hashes before parsing/comparison, are left untouched and enter final byte rechecks.
